import requests, os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
os.makedirs('/tmp/pdb',exist_ok=True)
def dl(p):
    f=f"/tmp/pdb/{p}_asm1.cif"
    if not os.path.exists(f): open(f,"wb").write(requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{p}-assembly1.cif",timeout=180).content)
    return f
def parse(path):
    lines=open(path).read().splitlines();cols=[];rows=[];i=0
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith('loop_'):
            j=i+1;tmp=[]
            while j<len(lines) and lines[j].strip().startswith('_'): tmp.append(lines[j].strip());j+=1
            if tmp and tmp[0].startswith('_atom_site.'):
                cols=[t.split('.')[1] for t in tmp];k=j
                while k<len(lines) and not lines[k].startswith('#') and not lines[k].startswith('loop_'):
                    s=lines[k].strip()
                    if s: rows.append(s.split())
                    k+=1
                break
        i+=1
    d=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols)
    for c in ['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']: d[c]=pd.to_numeric(d[c],errors='coerce')
    d['auth_seq_id']=pd.to_numeric(d['auth_seq_id'],errors='coerce')
    return d[(d.type_symbol!='H')&(d.label_comp_id!='HOH')].reset_index(drop=True)
SETUP={"5CCB":[("5CCB","B","A","A-2","C")],"5CCX":[("5CCX","B","A","A-2","C")],
       "5CD1":[("5CD1_D","D","C","A","E"),("5CD1_B","B","A","C","F")]}
rec=[]
for pid in SETUP:
    d=parse(dl(pid))
    for lab,m6,cis,tr,trna in SETUP[pid]:
        P=d[d.label_asym_id==m6].reset_index(drop=True); kp=cKDTree(P[['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].values)
        for ch,kind in [(trna,'tRNA'),(cis,'TRMT61A'),(tr,'TRMT61A')]:
            Q=d[d.label_asym_id==ch].reset_index(drop=True)
            dm=kp.sparse_distance_matrix(cKDTree(Q[['Cartn_x','Cartn_y','Cartn_z']].values),4.0).tocoo()
            for i,j,v in zip(dm.row,dm.col,dm.data): rec.append((lab,kind,int(P.auth_seq_id[i])))
CT=pd.DataFrame(rec,columns=['model','kind','r6']).drop_duplicates()
nm=CT.groupby(['kind','r6']).model.nunique()
trna_res=sorted(nm.loc['tRNA'][nm.loc['tRNA']>=2].index); p61_res=sorted(nm.loc['TRMT61A'][nm.loc['TRMT61A']>=2].index)
# ---- conservation ----
aas="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
b62="""A4 R-1,5 N-2,0,6 D-2,-2,1,6 C0,-3,-3,-3,9 Q-1,1,0,0,-3,5 E-1,0,0,2,-4,2,5 G0,-2,0,-1,-3,-2,-2,6 H-2,0,1,-1,-3,0,0,-2,8 I-1,-3,-3,-3,-1,-3,-3,-4,-3,4 L-1,-2,-3,-4,-1,-2,-3,-4,-3,2,4 K-1,2,0,-1,-3,1,1,-2,-1,-3,-2,5 M-1,-1,-2,-3,-1,0,-2,-3,-2,1,2,-1,5 F-2,-3,-3,-3,-2,-3,-3,-3,-1,0,0,-3,0,6 P-1,-2,-2,-1,-3,-1,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,-1,-2,-4,7 S1,-1,1,0,-1,0,0,0,-1,-2,-2,0,-1,-2,-1,4 T0,-1,0,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-2,-1,-1,-1,-1,-2,-1,1,5 W-3,-3,-4,-4,-2,-2,-3,-2,-2,-3,-2,-3,-1,1,-4,-3,-2,11 Y-2,-2,-2,-3,-2,-1,-2,-3,2,-1,-1,-2,-1,3,-3,-2,-2,2,7 V0,-3,-3,-3,-1,-2,-2,-3,-3,3,1,-2,1,-1,-2,-2,0,-3,-1,4"""
B62={}
for tok in b62.split():
    a=tok[0]
    for k,v in enumerate([int(x) for x in tok[1:].split(',')]): B62[(a,aas[k])]=v; B62[(aas[k],a)]=v
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1);pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1);pY[0,j]=2
    S=np.array([[B62.get((a,b),-1) for b in s2] for a in s1],dtype=float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            o=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(o));M[i,j]=o[k]+S[i-1,j-1];pM[i,j]=k
            o2=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge,Iy[i-1,j]+go);k2=int(np.argmax(o2));Ix[i,j]=o2[k2];pX[i,j]=k2
            o3=(M[i,j-1]+go,Ix[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k3=int(np.argmax(o3));Iy[i,j]=o3[k3];pY[i,j]=k3
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax((M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-');ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]);ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1
    return ''.join(a1[::-1]),''.join(a2[::-1])
def fa(a): return ''.join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:]).strip()
ORTH=[('Q8CE96','mouse'),('Q2T9V5','cow'),('Q6DF58','frog'),('Q32LR0','zebrafish'),('Q7KTM0','fly'),
      ('Q54UB1','Dictyostelium'),('Q9HGL4','S. pombe'),('P41814','S. cerevisiae')]
hum=fa('Q9UJA5'); cols={}
for acc,org in ORTH:
    a1,a2=nw(hum,fa(acc)); hi=0; col=['-']*len(hum)
    for x,y in zip(a1,a2):
        if x!='-': col[hi]=y; hi+=1
    cols[org]=col
MT=pd.DataFrame(cols,index=np.arange(1,len(hum)+1))
hv=np.array(list(hum))
id8=(MT.values==hv[:,None]).mean(axis=1)
id4=(MT[['fly','Dictyostelium','S. pombe','S. cerevisiae']].values==hv[:,None]).mean(axis=1)
cons=pd.DataFrame({'pos':np.arange(1,len(hum)+1),'aa':hv,'id8':id8,'id4':id4})
cons['cls']=np.where(cons.pos.isin(trna_res)&cons.pos.isin(p61_res),'both',
             np.where(cons.pos.isin(trna_res),'tRNA',np.where(cons.pos.isin(p61_res),'TRMT61A','none')))
inv=cons[(cons.id8==1)&cons.cls.isin(['tRNA','both'])]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,7.2))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,height_ratios=[1.25,1],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.3)
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
colmap={'none':'0.85','TRMT61A':'#6a8f3a','tRNA':'#2f6f9f','both':'#8a2f8a'}
ax.bar(cons.pos, cons.id4, color=[colmap[c] for c in cons.cls], width=1.0)
for p,a in zip(inv.pos,inv.aa):
    ax.annotate(f"{a}{p}", (p,1.02), rotation=90, ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color='#1b3f5c')
ax.set_ylim(0,1.35); ax.set_xlim(0,500)
ax.set_xlabel('human TRMT6 residue (Q9UJA5 numbering, identical to PDB author numbering)')
ax.set_ylabel('identity to human\n(fly, Dictyostelium,\nS. pombe, S. cerevisiae)')
ax.set_title('TRMT6 interface residues and their conservation. Labels: tRNA contacts invariant in all 8 orthologs')
ax.legend(handles=[Patch(color=colmap['tRNA'],label='contacts tRNA'),Patch(color=colmap['TRMT61A'],label='contacts TRMT61A'),
                   Patch(color=colmap['both'],label='contacts both'),Patch(color=colmap['none'],label='no interface contact')],
          frameon=False,ncol=4,fontsize=9,loc='upper left')

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
order=['none','TRMT61A','tRNA','both']; dat=[cons[cons.cls==c].id4.values for c in order]
bp=ax.boxplot(dat,labels=['no\ncontact','TRMT61A','tRNA','both'],patch_artist=True,widths=0.6,showfliers=False)
for b,c in zip(bp['boxes'],[colmap[c] for c in order]): b.set_facecolor(c); b.set_alpha(0.75)
for i,v in enumerate(dat): ax.plot(np.random.normal(i+1,0.07,len(v)),v,'.',ms=3,color='0.25',alpha=0.5)
u,p=mannwhitneyu(cons[cons.cls.isin(['tRNA','both'])].id4,cons[cons.cls=='none'].id4,alternative='greater')
ax.set_ylabel('identity to 4 deep orthologs'); ax.set_title(f'tRNA contacts vs non-interface\nMann-Whitney p = {p:.1e}',fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1:])
ax.axis('off')
txt=("Division of labour measured in 5CCB (assembly 1, substrate complex)\n"
     "  TRMT6 buries 1701 A2 of the tRNA it holds; TRMT61A buries 1440 A2 of the same tRNA\n"
     "  TRMT6 touches 24 nucleotides: T-stem 49-53/64-65, T-loop 54-59, variable loop 44-47,\n"
     "     anticodon stem 30-31/42-43, D-stem/D-loop 21-22\n"
     "  TRMT61A touches 17 nucleotides: acceptor stem 3-4/71-73, D-loop 15-19, T-loop 55-60\n"
     "  Closest TRMT6 atom to SAH: Asn94 OD1, 4.14 A (second shell, no direct bond)\n"
     "  TRMT6 H-bonds to the flipped target nucleotide are all to its backbone:\n"
     "     His441 NE2-OP1 2.66 A, Lys145 NZ-OP2 2.75 A, Gln434 NE2-OP1 2.88 A\n"
     "  No TRMT6 atom reaches the A58 base N1 or the SAH sulfur")
ax.text(0,1,txt,va='top',ha='left',fontsize=9.5,family='monospace')
plt.show()
print("invariant tRNA-contact residues:", list(zip(inv.aa,inv.pos)))
